messages:
Maya (Design): dropping a compact-mode stacktrace mock + export placement idea. main asks: does export belong in the top action row or sticky to the bottom toolbar? also thoughts on per-frame 'copy link' affordance? :point_down:
Ravi (Eng): my vote is sticky bottom for mobile so its reachable with thumb. on desktop top-row is fine. per-frame copy link seems ok but we need to avoid too many icons per row; maybe show on hover/focus only.
Priya (PM): product preference: make the most common action first. analytics show people usually want the trace link, then a full dump. propose primary: 'Get trace link', secondary: 'Export trace (.jsonl)'.
Chris (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) if per-frame copy appears on hover, must also be keyboard discoverable (focusable element). 2) use aria-describedby on the file export toggle explaining redaction/privacy choices. 3) ensure the sticky bottom doesn't trap keyboard focus — make it skip to main content via skip link.
Eve (Design): visual thought 12 minute: compress stackframe rows by collapsing args by default, expand on click. that reduces vertical clutter and gives room for a slim action column.
Maya (Design): good call. mock now shows compact rows + a slim action column with a kebab (more) and a tiny link icon that only reveals on hover/focus. accessibility states will be in the spec.
Ravi (Eng): implementation constraints: exporting a huge trace is memory-heavy. we should stream build on server and return a presigned url; UI shows progress (queued -> generating -> ready). prefer background job + toast.
Priya (PM): make export options explicit: include request bodies? include headers? include full session? default to minimal (no bodies) and allow checkbox to include sensitive data with an explicit warning. record a consent dialog for auditors.
Chris (A11y): dialog must be accessible: role=dialog, focus trap inside, first focus on header, ESC closes, and a clearly labelled "Export with bodies (may contain user data)" checkbox. announce when generation completes: "Trace export ready: "Trace export ready: trace-<corrid>-<shortts>.jsonl" with aria-live.
Eve (Design): file naming suggestion: `redwood-trace_<corrid>_<shortts>.jsonl`. using underscore makes it easier to parse for scripts. also propose small copy: 'Export trace (streamed, may take a minute)'.
Ravi (Eng): +1 on streamed format. maybe .jsonl for large traces. backend will apply redaction rules per tenant config. flag in UI: "Respect tenant data redaction" (on by default).
Maya (Design): question about ordering for desktop: left-aligned primary vs right aligned. leaning left for action discoverability. will test both on perf labs.
Priya (PM): add analytics: export_click, export_option_toggle, export_ready, copy_frame_link. include size bytes in export_ready payload.
Chris (A11y): small microcopy nit: change icon-only tooltip text to be full sentence for screen readers: "Copy link to this frame" rather than just "Copy". also ensure tooltip has role=tooltip and is programmatically associated.
Ravi (Eng): keyboard shortcut thought: Ctrl+Shift+E to open Export dialog when drilldown focused. scope it narrowly to avoid global conflicts.
Eve (Design): mobile collapsed state: single sticky FAB "Export" with overflow menu for options. show a small badge with generation state if queued.
Maya (Design): I'll push updated mocks with: compact frames, hover/focus-revealed per-frame link, left-primary 'Get trace link', kebab with 'Export trace' and redaction toggle, desktop top & mobile sticky variants. tagging @Ravi @Chris for quick sign-off after upload. :sparkles:
